subject: aftd
title: AF.TD.------TH.AF.ALGN.
description: Chart on book p. 340 (PCC-24). AFTD (affinity tendencies) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; TH-AF-ALGN (thrust affinity alignment) is the partner. The title names AF-TD (affinity tendencies); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: PRI-INFO (principle information), with the (N) prefix. From TH-AF-ALGN: AFL (affinity alignment). From PRI-INFO: TH-AF-ALGN and ATTN (attraction), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From AFL: CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus). From CULT-INFO-F: INDIV-DY-RT (individual dynamic reality) and DYM-F (dynamic functionalism). From INDIV-DY-RT: PART (participation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From PART: COS-P (cosmic particulars).
